we have a "mark_complete" checkbox for prescriptions right. as long as this is not dirty, we should auto-toggle this based on the following logic:

1. checked only if ALL/EVERY of the selectable/editable line items / medications are is_selected.

2. unchecked if any of the selectable/editable line items/medications are not is_selected.

note that, this auto-toggle feature should only happen as long as that checkbox is not dirty. while setting it, do not make it dirty

data.reasoningText:
I need to set up an effect that monitors the isSelected state of items and automatically updates markComplete when that field hasn't been manually edited. The tricky part is distinguishing between programmatic updates via setValue and user interactions through the Controller field—React Hook Form marks fields as dirty when the user changes them directly, but I can use shouldDirty: false to avoid that when setting values programmatically.

The dirtyFields tracking works by comparing current values against defaultValues, so if a user checks and then unchecks a box, it'll revert to clean state, which is fine for this use case. I'll need to subscribe to formState.dirtyFields in the render to make this reactive, then implement the logic in the PrescriptionSummary component. Let me check the schema to understand the structure better.

I'm setting up the PrescriptionSummary component to watch the form's items array and track whether the mark complete field has been modified, then filtering for dispenseable medications to determine if the completion option should be available.

I'm using a useEffect hook that automatically updates the mark complete value based on whether all eligible items are selected, but only if the user hasn't manually changed it — and I'm relying on the `.every()` method's behavior where an empty array returns true, which makes sense since if there are no dispenseable items left, the prescription should be marked complete.

For the form state subscription, I need to make sure `getFieldState` properly triggers the proxy subscription through `formState.dirtyFields`, which is the documented pattern in React Hook Form v7. I'll add the useEffect import and write out the implementation.

data.content: Added an effect in `PrescriptionSummary` that syncs `markComplete` with the dispenseable line items' `isSelected` state — checked only when every dispenseable item is selected — and it bails out once the field becomes dirty. The `setValue` call uses `shouldDirty: false` / `shouldTouch: false` so the auto-toggle itself never marks it dirty.
